working_definition: Visceral muscle cells of the crop from the gut analysis (Li et al. 2022; Manual Annotation, broad class muscle cell).

best_match.fbbt_definition: Any visceral muscle cell (FBbt:00005070) that is part of some foregut.

justification: FBbt only has adult crop circular muscle cell (a child of foregut muscle cell and adult visceral muscle cell); no term covers all crop visceral muscle. Foregut muscle cell is the most specific true parent of crop muscle cells (the crop is adult-only, so the non-adult-specific parent is acceptable).

other_candidates.fbbt_definition: Cell that is part of the circular muscle fibers of the adult crop.
other_candidates.reason_rejected: Only the circular fibres; the authors' type is all crop visceral muscle.

other_candidates.fbbt_definition: Muscle cell of a visceral muscle of the adult.
other_candidates.reason_rejected: Less specific than foregut muscle cell.

recommendation: Map to FBbt:00058266 (broad, low confidence); curator may prefer adult visceral muscle cell.
